notes: The panel's arrangement - room assignments, tile order and tile sizes - now rides along to the dashboard server with the rest of the settings, and Settings > Layout can copy it as JSON. Until now it lived only in this tablet's DataStore: a wipe lost an arrangement built up over months, and there was no way to read it off a wall-mounted device. A panel that has never been arranged won't overwrite a stored layout with its empties. Requires the matching server update to persist (older servers drop the key harmlessly).
